summary: @servicetitan/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers, per-function proxy string maps) and, at npm install time, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the bun binary to a temp path, chmods it executable (mode 0755), and invokes it via execFileSync against the co-shipped math_init.js at the package root. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file using a custom rotated string/char-code table with a shift-based decoder — the shape of a packed loader. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or a 727KB obfuscated payload; the alternate runtime is used to execute code outside Node's normal resolution and to evade Node-focused static analysis. Both the loader and the payload fire automatically on any npm install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
